description: This file is a Perl script designed for testing internal components of the curl testing harness. It provides command-line interaction to control test servers and protocols, enabling developers to manually or programmatically test curl internals like protocol handling, server startup/shutdown, and other test environment configurations.

methods.name: logmsg
methods.description: Logs messages with special handling for WSL shells, ensures correct line endings.

methods.name: parseprotocols
methods.description: Parses a string of protocols into an array, adding IPv6, Unix socket variants, and special protocols.

methods.name: init_protocols
methods.description: Initializes protocol list by querying the curl binary.

methods.name: init_tests
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, including logging and protocols.
